description:
QZ Tray enables secure raw printing and scanning from a web browser to local printers (including thermal, label, and receipt printers) via a small background tray application and a WebSocket connection.


2026-09-11
Features
- Switch to OpenJDK 25 for the main app #1216
- Switch to OpenJFX 27 for HTML printing #1216
- Switch to Apache Ivy for dependency management #1216
- Add LocalNetworkAccess detection examples #1441
- Add detailed printer crawling to the log files printer.details.debug=true #830
- Add API to fetch app details qz.api.getVersion({ details: true }) #1497
- Linux: Prompt for CUPS install when missing #1393
- Linux: Add support for Firefox Flatpak #1476
- Linux: Improve dark/light mode handling #1509
- Linux: Improve desktop scale factor support #1509
- Theming: Switch to formdev/DarkLaf #1216
Fixes
- WebSocket: Suppress notifications for idle timeouts #691
- API: Harden qz.websocket.isActive() #1458
- macOS: Fix XML parsing bug for when offline #1444
- Windows: Fix backwards compatibility issues with Windows 7 #435
- Support printers with leading spaces: #1464
- PDF: Fix printing of PDF annotations: #1481
Company Branded
- Add more provisioning options: https://qz.io/docs/company-branded#provisioning
- Add support for dark-mode "About" logos #1513
- Fix handling of unicode characters: #1469, #1511
- Fix dist.minimal #1474
- Fix security.wss.httpsonly #1482
- Improve security.wss.alloworigin to support multiple origins #1477
- Clean up duplicate cert entries #1490
Maintenance
- Chrome: Remove browser modification for qz:launch #1452
- Add regression tests for critical META-INF/services #1453
- WebSocket: Increase default header size for incoming connections #1460
- HTML: Fix parsing of WebKit version #1437
Security
- Windows: Sign NSIS libraries #436
- Hardening: Add security.print.tohost toggle #1479
- Hardening: Guard against traversing into file junctions #1487
- Hardening: Add Basic Constraints to CA SSL cert #1492
- Hardening: Restrict URI launches to sane flags #1493
- Bump dependent libs, JDK
Full Changelog: v2.2.6...v2.3.0
